messages:
alex: Heads-up: prod gateway -> model-v3 just started spiking 502s in eu-west and us-east, error rate +6% last 3m. Can we force fallback to v2 with an emergency toggle? :rotating_light:
mai: How fast do we need it? header injection or route pin? Header lets us scope by region, less blast radius.
ram: Header sounds right. Add a short TTL so it auto-expires after we stabilize. No manual debt.
sasha: FWIW ops-bot route toggle is global and slow to converge. Header at gateway is faster to propagate.
alex: Plan: inject header `x-rw-emergency-fallback: on` at gateway for affected shards. route-policy will match and prefer v2. Need someone to run CLI toggle + set ttl=600s. I'll ping support + console.
ops-bot: @alex acknowledged. Suggested command:
```
rwctl toggle emergency-fallback --header "x-rw-emergency-fallback:on" --scope=prod --regions=eu-west,us-east --ttl=600
```
deploy-bot: toggle preflight: rule exists=yes, policy conflicts=none, dry-run=ok.
mai: I'll apply in ~2m and watch telemetry. tagging @sasha to record audit.
sasha: creating quick dashboard row: gateway.header_fallback.count and gateway.fallback_success.rate. Also add a temporary alert to watch fallback-progress.
terry: Console UX note: toggles show but TTL is not surfaced. Can we surface TTL + who toggled in the console incident banner? People forget to check TTL.
ram: Also ensure toggle actor is pushed into incident timeline for compliance.
mai: Applying now.
ops-bot: action logged: toggle applied by mai at 2534560024, ttl=600, regions=[eu-west,us-east].
alex: seeing inbound header counts rising, 502s dropping in eu-west. :thumbsup:
sasha: fallback-success improving. Some stray traffic hitting v3 in ap-south due to stale route cache — will flush edges.
ram: flushing cache: `rwctl cache flush --scope=prod --regions=ap-south`
deploy-bot: cache flush completed at 2534560048.
mai: Monitoring for 5m post-toggle. If not steady, escalate to route pin per shard.
alex: Next steps: 1) keep TTL 10m, 2) create short postmortem doc (link placeholder), 3) console TODO: show TTL + toggler + quick-revert button.
sasha: I'll push telemetry tags and add the dashboard panel. Will also add an alert that triggers if fallback success < 95% after 3m.
ram: After TTL expiry, we should verify v3 ramps via canary policy rather than immediate global flip. Schedule controlled ramp.
ops-bot: incident note added to timeline.
